name: Measure market, credit and leverage risk and monitor limits (daily risk run)
summary: Every business day the total fund and market risk team, independent of the investment departments, measures how much the fund could lose and checks the result against Board and management limits. An overnight run in the risk platform calculates potential loss, the equity/debt risk ratio, active risk, credit value-at-risk and sensitivities; analysts then check data quality and fix gaps, associates reconcile positions to the book of record, explain why risk moved and verify the liquidity and leverage figures from Total Fund Management, and senior staff review limit use, talk to the first line about warnings and validate any possible breach before a director issues a breach notice. The daily report is reviewed and published, and at month end a summary goes to the Investment Risk Committee and quarterly to the Board. The work is slowed by data gaps, proxies for private holdings and waiting for upstream inputs.

baseline.org_archetype: A national pension fund manager of about C$540 billion whose Risk group reports to the Chief Financial and Risk Officer and independently monitors Board limits cascaded to department-level limits.
baseline.notes: Board limits were cascaded to management-level department limits in F2021 and broadened in F2022. A risk technology and data modernisation started in F2022, so the period runs on a vendor risk platform plus spreadsheets.

trigger: The daily valuation and positions are final, together with the liquidity forecast from Total Fund Management and the current strategic targets and limits.
end_state: The daily risk report is reviewed and published, any breach has been notified, results and data issues are archived, and on month end the summary has gone to committees.

volume.seasonality: One run per business day. Month and quarter ends add committee and Board reporting; volatile markets raise warnings and breach checks.

evidence.note: Potential investment losses are monitored daily (Note 7.1); business days per month from the calendar.

systems.name: Risk analytics platform (potential loss, limits, stress tests)
Cloud enterprise data platform and data warehouse
SimCorp Dimension investment book of record (portfolio accounting, treasury, performance)
Bloomberg terminals, market data and trade messaging

steps.name: Load positions, prices and proxy mappings
steps.description: After the daily valuation is final, a scheduled job loads positions and valuations from the book of record, market data histories and the mappings that represent private holdings by public market proxies into the risk platform.
inputs: daily net asset value and positions

error.defect_description: Missing positions, stale or missing price histories, or private holdings without a current proxy.

evidence.note: Risk measures depend on timely, complete aggregation of positions and data; the F2021 report describes a new process to systematically calculate measures on a timely basis. Timing is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Run the overnight risk engine
steps.description: The risk platform calculates one-year and five-year potential loss, the equity/debt risk ratio, active risk, credit value-at-risk, sensitivities to equity, rates, spreads and currency, and leverage measures by account, pool, department and program.

error.defect_description: A job fails or runs on a partial data set.

evidence.note: Suite of measures named in Note 7: one-year potential loss not exceeded 19 times out of 20, five-year potential loss, active risk, equity/debt ratio, credit value-at-risk. Timing is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Check run completion and input data quality
steps.description: The analyst checks that every portfolio ran, that position counts and market values match the valuation, that no price series is stale or missing, and that day-over-day jumps in measures have a plausible cause. Problems are logged before anyone uses the numbers.

error.defect_description: A proxy gap is accepted and understates a department's risk.

control.basis: Data, model and user-developed application controls maintained by Finance, Analytics and Risk under the Integrated Risk Framework

evidence.note: Formal protocols for data, models and user-developed applications; accurate and timely risk data aggregation. Issue rate and times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Fix data issues and rerun
steps.description: The analyst asks investment data operations or risk technology to correct the security master entry, price history or proxy mapping, or applies an approved temporary proxy, and reruns the affected portfolios.

error.defect_description: A temporary proxy is left in place after the real data arrive.

evidence.note: Common daily dependency on reference data and technology teams. Times and probabilities are the author's estimates for a large pension fund risk team.

steps.name: Reconcile risk positions with the book of record
steps.description: The associate ties total market value and exposures by account and department in the risk platform to the daily valuation and the book of record, within tolerance, and follows up any portfolio that does not tie.

control.basis: Reconciliation of risk system positions to the book of record before reporting

evidence.note: Reconciliation of risk positions is standard practice. Times and probabilities are the author's estimates for a large pension fund risk team.

steps.name: Explain day-over-day changes in risk
steps.description: The associate attributes the change in potential loss and key exposures since yesterday to market moves, trades, new private investments, flows and any model or proxy change, so the report can say why risk moved.

error.defect_description: A change is attributed to the wrong driver.

evidence.note: Contribution to potential loss is reported by department. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Load and check liquidity and leverage inputs
steps.description: The analyst loads the liquidity coverage ratio, liquidity buffer and recourse leverage figures that Total Fund Management publishes, checks them against the risk platform's own positions and questions anything that does not agree.

control.basis: Independent second line verification of first line liquidity and leverage measures

evidence.note: Board-approved liquidity and leverage limits are independently monitored by Risk. Waiting on TFM's late-morning report is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Compare measures with limits and thresholds
steps.description: The risk platform compares each measure with Board limits and the management-level limits and thresholds cascaded to departments, and produces a utilisation table with flags for measures near or over a level.

error.defect_description: A limit in the register is out of date after the annual policy update.

control.basis: Board-approved Integrated Risk Policy limits and management-level limits and thresholds

evidence.note: Equity/debt limit 80-90% (base plan), active risk limit 450 bps, LCR limit 1.0x; Board limits cascaded to department-level limits in F2021.

steps.name: Review limit utilisation and flags
steps.description: The senior associate reads the utilisation table, separates real exposure changes from data artefacts and decides whether any flag needs a conversation with the first line or a breach check.

evidence.note: Risk independently challenges the first line and monitors limits. Shares and times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Discuss a threshold warning with the first line
steps.description: The senior associate contacts the department or TFM risk owner about a measure near its threshold, records their explanation and planned action, and adds the commentary to the report.

evidence.note: Second line challenges first line risk management. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Validate a possible limit breach
steps.description: A principal reruns the measure with corrected data if needed, checks the methodology and proxies behind it and confirms the position with the first line before anything is declared a breach.

evidence.note: Validation before escalation is common practice. Times and probabilities are the author's estimates for a large pension fund risk team.

steps.name: Issue a limit breach notice and escalate
steps.description: A risk director issues the breach notice to the accountable department head and the CIO, informs the CFRO and, for a Board limit, prepares the escalation to the CEO and the Board committee set out in the Risk Policy.

control.basis: Breach treatment and escalation procedures in the Integrated Risk Policy (Investment Statement section 9.11)

evidence.note: Breach escalation is set in the Risk Policy; variations outside market risk limits need prior Board approval except de minimis CEO approval. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Prepare the daily risk report
steps.description: The associate assembles the daily report: limit utilisation, potential loss by account and department, key sensitivities, liquidity and leverage, drivers of change and any threshold or breach commentary.

error.defect_description: A stale chart or wrong figure is pasted into the report.

evidence.note: Regular risk reports to senior management; the management committee received risk information weekly in F2020. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Review and sign off the daily risk report
steps.description: A principal checks the figures against the utilisation table, reads the commentary and signs off the report, or sends it back for corrections.

control.basis: Four-eyes review of risk reports before distribution

evidence.note: Review step assumed from team structure. Times and probabilities are the author's estimates for a large pension fund risk team.

steps.name: Publish the daily risk report
steps.description: The associate distributes the report to TFM, the investment departments, the CFRO and risk leadership and posts it to the shared risk site.

evidence.note: Regular risk reports to senior management. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Archive results and log data issues
steps.description: The analyst saves the day's measures and report, logs data issues, temporary proxies and reruns, and updates the open-issues list for the data and technology teams.

evidence.note: Record-keeping step assumed. Times and probabilities are the author's estimates for a large pension fund risk team.

steps.name: Prepare the monthly risk and limit summary
steps.description: At month end the associate compiles the month's limit utilisation, breaches and remediation, potential loss trends and stress results into the summary for the Investment Risk Committee and, each quarter, the Board's Risk Committee.

error.defect_description: Inconsistent figures between monthly and daily reports.

evidence.note: Investment Risk Committee monitors risk exposures; Board receives risk reporting at least quarterly. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Review the monthly risk summary
steps.description: A risk director reviews the summary for accuracy and messaging, checks that every breach and threshold event is explained and sends it back if needed.

evidence.note: Review layer assumed. Times and probabilities are the author's estimates for a large pension fund risk team.

steps.name: Approve the monthly risk report for committees and the Board
steps.description: The Head of Risk approves the summary, adds the overall view and submits it to the Investment Risk Committee and, at quarter end, to the Board package.
outputs: risk report for committees and Board

control.basis: Management reports total risk and limit use to the Board at least quarterly (Investment Statement section 9.10)

evidence.note: Quarterly Board reporting of risk exposures and limits. Times are the author's estimates.

exceptions.name: Data issue or failed job
exceptions.description: Missing prices, positions or proxy mappings, or a failed job, force a fix and rerun before measures can be used.

exceptions.name: Positions do not tie to the book of record
exceptions.description: Risk platform totals differ from the valuation beyond tolerance and the cause must be found and rerun.

exceptions.name: Threshold warning
exceptions.description: A department or fund measure nears its management threshold; Risk records the first line's explanation and planned action.

exceptions.name: Possible or confirmed limit breach
exceptions.description: A measure appears over a limit; a principal validates it and, if confirmed, a director issues a breach notice that starts the breach escalation process.

exceptions.name: Month-end committee reporting
exceptions.description: On the last business day of the month the team also prepares, reviews and approves the monthly risk summary for the Investment Risk Committee and, quarterly, the Board.

pain_points.description: Risk numbers depend on overnight positions, price histories and proxy mappings for private holdings; gaps force reruns and temporary proxies that can linger.

evidence.note: F2021 roadmap to modernise risk technology and data; aggregating risk fully, quickly and accurately is a known industry weakness.

pain_points.description: The report waits for the liquidity and leverage figures that Total Fund Management publishes late morning.

evidence.note: Author's estimate of the daily dependency.

pain_points.description: Limit registers, attribution and reports are partly assembled in spreadsheets, so figures are checked twice and stale numbers can slip into reports.

evidence.note: Author's estimate of 2019 to 2022 tooling before the risk technology modernisation.

pain_points.description: The cascade of Board limits to department-level limits and thresholds multiplied the number of measures to check and explain each day.

evidence.note: Limits cascaded to departments in F2021 and expanded across more dimensions in F2022.

sources.title: The model fund F2022 Annual Report (fiscal year ended March 31, 2022)
sources.supports: Integrated Risk Policy approved by the Board at least annually with risk limits, statements and targets; potential investment losses monitored daily and reported to the Board at least quarterly; Risk independently measures and monitors compliance with all limits; suite of measures including one-year potential loss (19 times out of 20), five-year potential loss, active risk, equity/debt risk ratio (limit 80-90% base plan, 50-60% additional plan), active risk limit 450 bps, credit value-at-risk, stress scenarios and model validation; Investment Risk Committee chaired by the CFRO monitors risk exposures; F2022 expanded investment risk limits and thresholds; remained within all Board limits

sources.title: The model fund F2021 Annual Report (fiscal year ended March 31, 2021)
sources.supports: Board limits cascaded to management-level limits for each investment department in F2021, with more granular limits and thresholds planned for F2022; new risk limits framework with a process to systematically calculate measures on a timely basis; roadmap to modernise risk technology and data; one-year potential loss by department (TFM C$30.6 billion of C$89.0 billion for base plan); Risk develops, measures and monitors compliance with all approved limits

sources.title: The model fund 2020 Annual Report
sources.supports: Risk Policy approved annually formalises risk constraints, measures and Absolute Risk Operating Ranges in equity/debt terms; Risk group independently provides standard risk metrics, sensitivity tests and stress scenarios to the Board, senior management and the Investment Planning Committee; the management committee received risk information weekly and reviewed portfolio risks at least monthly; Long-Term Risk model uses conditional value-at-risk over five years

sources.title: Statement of Investment Objectives, Policies, Return Expectations and Risk Management for the Investment Portfolios of the Base plan and the Additional plan (effective April 2, 2025)
sources.supports: Board approves market risk limits in equity/debt and absolute potential loss (value-at-risk) terms and liquidity and leverage limits annually; limits wide enough for normal daily variation; variation outside limits needs prior Board approval except de minimis variances approved by the CEO; management monitors market, credit, liquidity and leverage risks daily; management-level limits and thresholds reported to the Board at least quarterly; breach treatment and escalation in the Risk Policy

sources.title: Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting (BCBS 239)
sources.supports: Financial institutions in the crisis were unable to aggregate risk exposures and identify concentrations fully, quickly and accurately; principles aim to strengthen risk data aggregation and internal risk reporting

assumptions: The process covers the daily run and the month-end summary; annual limit calibration, stress testing and model validation are separate processes.

Threshold warnings on about 12% of days and possible breaches on about 4% are estimates; the organisation reports remaining within all Board limits, so most breaches are of management-level limits or thresholds.
The liquidity and leverage check is shown as running alongside the change attribution; the simulation treats it as sequential with a shortened wait.
fte_on_process covers only the daily cycle; the 30-person total fund and market risk team also runs stress tests, model work, transaction reviews and projects.
Loaded hourly costs come from the organisation file and include large incentive pay.
